Happily, we of the Chekkoo clan will be mosht pleashed to accept hyoor cargo of weapons in their shtead.|[[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] clansman to [[Shella Rinou]]|<ref name="SOTEPG">{{WEGCite|story=A Brief Visit to Rodia|book=Shadows of the Empire Planets Guide}}</ref>}}
A '''male Rodian''' was a member of the [[Chekkoo clan/Legends|Chekkoo clan]]. [[Gender/Legends|He]] was lanky, wore only a [[loincloth]], and spoke [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]] with a moderate lisp.

When [[Shella Rinou]] and [[Kelric (Herglic)|Kelric]] arrived within the [[Chekkoo Province]] on [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]], this [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] greeted them&mdash;with the business end of a [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]]. He claimed that Shella's [[Unidentified smuggling client|client]] had "shucumbed to the dangers of our [[Ekloska forest]]s." When Shella and Kelric refused to hand over their weapons shipment, the Rodian signaled for his clansmen to fire upon their [[Listing Dewback|ship]]. The [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]], however, escaped in time.
